Garage description
The formula of the "Swash" cover was stolen from a secret laboratory codenamed "Aqua", specializing in genetic experiments on fish. Thanks to its special heat-reflecting properties, this paint gives the air inside the tank a refreshing seaside freshness.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on July 29, 2010.
Legacy paint description:
A multifunctional paint that somewhat reduces the damage inflicted by Smoky, Firebird, Twins and Isida. Works well in short to mid-range battles. Sports a natural masking texture that makes your tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
